text: URGENT! 7.2 magnitude earthquake tremor damaged apartment in San Francisco CA. 6 family members stuck under concrete rubble, need rescue team and paramedics!
Building collapsed after seismic shaking in Tokyo Japan. 3 people trapped in elevator shaft, crying for help!
Severe earthquake tremor in Kathmandu Nepal. Historic building caved in, 8 victims injured under debris needing immediate first aid and shelter.
Strong earthquake shaking felt in Los Angeles CA. Wall cracks reported in school building, students evacuated to field safely.
Earthquake aftermath in Istanbul Turkey. 5 residents trapped in basement of damaged structure, need heavy cutters and emergency medical team.
Minor aftershock tremor registered in Taiwan with no reported damage or casualties. All subway services operating normally.
SOS! Earthquake tremor collapsed ceiling in San Jose CA. 2 elderly residents bleeding from head, urgent ambulance required!
Disaster relief tents, warm blankets, and canned food required for 50 earthquake survivors in Christchurch New Zealand.
Seismic monitoring station registered 4.5 quake off the coast. Tsunami warning evaluated and cleared by authorities.
Emergency rescue team digging through building rubble in Mexico City following major earthquake tremor. 4 children trapped inside.
Earthquake tremor destroyed local hospital wing in Port-au-Prince. Urgent medical supplies, bandages, and temporary field surgical tent needed.
Community donation drive collecting warm blankets, dry clothes, and non-perishable food for earthquake survivors.
Deep fissures in road surface following 6.8 magnitude quake in Anchorage Alaska. Power grid down, urgent generator and fuel needed.
Building inspection teams certifying residential structures after minor tremor in Seattle WA.
CRITICAL! Apartment block caved in after earthquake in Naples Italy. 10 residents trapped under concrete slabs, crying for water and rescue!
